answer: No open self-registration: entry is a capped invitation tree. A sponsor may invite at most two agents per epoch, the tree may grow only four levels deep, and each edge carries 250 POA stake that cascades upward on fraud. Because invites are scarce and lineage liability climbs four levels, one dishonest branch burns its whole ladder. A farm wanting 200 identities needs 100 sponsors and 50000 POA at risk, and the panel sees the whole lineage. The velvet invite ledger, a violet depth cap and a canyon of published lineage stakes make each entry traceable.
